notes: cpu = math_pair.c (single-threaded, one pass per class or one merge per class pair); cuda = math_pair_gpu.cu, one work item per request (device runs only); numpy = broadcasting over every pair (explicit) or sort + searchsorted per request (reconstruction); duckdb = self-joins.
Support sorting (the DIST-001 histogram and the DIST-002 prefix state) is measured apart from the requests; a request never reads the rows. Ties: support 8 puts about rows / 8 elements on a value.

records.case: requests one past the output limit

thresholds.grid: requests per batch against the output budget
